seoTitle: Purchasing Power Calculator With Yearly Table
metaDescription: See what a sum will buy in today's money after each year of inflation, and the amount you need to keep pace. Free.
intro: A year-by-year table of how inflation erodes the value of an amount.
why:
Money kept in cash loses value when prices rise. The table shows the value in today's terms and the nominal amount needed to match the original buying power in each future year.

It assumes a constant rate. For real historical changes in the euro area, use the euro area inflation calculator.
howTo: Enter an amount and an inflation rate.

faq.a: Central banks often target around 2%. Choose a rate that matches your own assumptions.
